"""Canonical embedded-source assembly and per-definition geometry payload validation."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy

from .assembly_validation_common import (
    DEFAULT_POLICY,
    MAX_FRAMES,
    MAX_INSTANCES,
    MAX_JOINTS,
    MAX_PARTS,
    MAX_TRIANGLES,
    MAX_VERTICES,
    _frame,
    _hash,
    _identifier,
    _keys,
    _number,
    _records,
    _require,
    _same_supplied,
    _text,
    _vector,
    canonical_digest,
    fingerprint,
)


def _policy(value):
    _keys(value, DEFAULT_POLICY)
    for key, lower, upper in (
        ("linear_tolerance_mm", 1e-9, 1),
        ("volume_tolerance_mm3", 1e-15, 1),
        ("linear_deflection_mm", 0.001, 10),
    ):
        _number(value[key], minimum=lower, bound=upper)


def _presets(canonical, instances):
    presets = _records(canonical["verification_presets"], 8)
    for preset in presets.values():
        _keys(preset, {"id", "name", "kind", "requirements", "policy"})
        _identifier(preset["id"])
        _text(preset["name"])
        _require(
            preset["kind"] in {"clearance", "interference_only"}, "invalid verification preset kind"
        )
        _policy(preset["policy"])
        requirements = _records(preset["requirements"], 120)
        _require(
            bool(requirements) == (preset["kind"] == "clearance"),
            "preset kind contradicts engineering requirements",
        )
        pairs = set()
        for requirement in requirements.values():
            _keys(requirement, {"id", "name", "instances", "minimum_mm"})
            _identifier(requirement["id"])
            _text(requirement["name"])
            pair = requirement["instances"]
            _require(
                type(pair) is list
                and len(pair) == 2
                and all(type(i) is str and i in instances for i in pair),
                "unknown requirement instance pair",
            )
            _require(
                pair[0] < pair[1] and tuple(pair) not in pairs,
                "duplicate or noncanonical requirement pair",
            )
            pairs.add(tuple(pair))
            _number(requirement["minimum_mm"], minimum=0, bound=1e6)
    active = canonical["active_verification_preset"]
    _require(
        active is None or type(active) is str and active in presets,
        "unknown active verification preset",
    )
    return presets


def _verification_basis(request, canonical, report):
    basis = report.get("verification_basis")
    if basis is None:
        _require(
            not report["poses"] and "effective_policy" not in report,
            "verification basis is missing",
        )
        return False, [], None
    _keys(basis, {"kind", "preset_id", "preset", "configured"})
    _require(type(basis["configured"]) is bool, "verification configuration flag is invalid")
    supplied_id = request.get("preset_id")
    if supplied_id is not None:
        _identifier(supplied_id)
    selected = canonical["active_verification_preset"] if supplied_id is None else supplied_id
    requirements = request.get("requirements")
    policy = request.get("policy")
    expected = {"kind": "not_requested", "preset_id": None, "preset": None, "configured": False}
    if request["action"] == "assembly_replay":
        _require(supplied_id is None, "replay unexpectedly selects a verification preset")
        resolved = []
    elif selected is not None:
        presets = {p["id"]: p for p in canonical["verification_presets"]}
        _require(
            selected in presets and requirements is None and policy is None,
            "saved preset has conflicting overrides or missing identity",
        )
        preset = presets[selected]
        expected.update(kind=preset["kind"], preset_id=selected, preset=preset, configured=True)
        policy = preset["policy"]
        resolved = [
            {"instances": r["instances"], "minimum_mm": r["minimum_mm"]}
            for r in preset["requirements"]
        ]
    else:
        _require(
            requirements is None or type(requirements) is list,
            "ad-hoc requirements must be an array",
        )
        configured = requirements is not None
        expected.update(
            kind=("ad_hoc_clearance" if requirements else "ad_hoc_interference_only")
            if configured
            else "unconfigured",
            configured=configured,
        )
        resolved = requirements or []
    _require(basis == expected, "verification basis changed configured intent or selected preset")
    _require(policy is None or type(policy) is dict, "invalid numerical policy")
    return expected["configured"], resolved, {**DEFAULT_POLICY, **(policy or {})}


def _canonical(request, result):
    canonical = result["canonical_assembly"]
    fields = {
        "kind",
        "assembly_schema_version",
        "id",
        "name",
        "length_unit",
        "angle_unit",
        "part_sources",
        "parts",
        "instances",
        "joints",
        "grounded_instance",
        "ground",
        "verification_presets",
        "active_verification_preset",
    }
    _keys(canonical, fields)
    _require(
        canonical["kind"] == "assembly"
        and type(canonical["assembly_schema_version"]) is int
        and canonical["assembly_schema_version"] == 1,
        "unsupported assembly schema",
    )
    _require(
        canonical["length_unit"] == "mm" and canonical["angle_unit"] == "rad",
        "unsupported assembly units",
    )
    _identifier(canonical["id"])
    _text(canonical["name"])
    _frame(canonical["ground"])
    raw = copy.deepcopy(request["assembly"])
    raw.setdefault("verification_presets", [])
    raw.setdefault("active_verification_preset", None)
    for preset in raw["verification_presets"]:
        for requirement in preset["requirements"]:
            requirement["instances"] = sorted(requirement["instances"])
    _same_supplied(raw, canonical)
    sources = _records(canonical["part_sources"], MAX_PARTS, "source_document_id")
    expected_sources = {}
    for source in sources.values():
        _keys(source, {"source_document_id", "source_digest", "document"})
        _text(source["source_document_id"], 128)
        _hash(source["source_digest"])
        _require(
            source["document"]["id"] == source["source_document_id"],
            "source document identity mismatch",
        )
        _require(
            canonical_digest(source["document"]) == source["source_digest"],
            "source content hash mismatch",
        )
        expected_sources[source["source_document_id"]] = source["source_digest"]
    # Source hashes already bind all canonical Part defaults. Assembly defaults
    # are restricted here; no additional frame, joint or record may be inserted.
    for source in raw["part_sources"]:
        source["document"] = sources[source["source_document_id"]]["document"]
    for field in ("parts", "instances", "joints"):
        for row in raw[field]:
            row.setdefault("name", row["id"])
            if field == "joints" and row["kind"] != "fixed":
                row.setdefault("limits", None)
            for frame in row.get("mate_frames", []):
                frame.setdefault("name", frame["id"])
    _require(raw == canonical, "canonical assembly differs from the requested snapshot")
    _hash(result["assembly_digest"])
    _require(
        canonical_digest(canonical) == result["assembly_digest"], "canonical assembly hash mismatch"
    )
    _require(result["source_hashes"] == expected_sources, "source hash set mismatch")
    parts = _records(canonical["parts"], MAX_PARTS)
    instances = _records(canonical["instances"], MAX_INSTANCES)
    joints = _records(canonical["joints"], MAX_JOINTS)
    _require(sources and parts and instances, "empty assembly")
    _presets(canonical, instances)
    frame_count = 0
    for part in parts.values():
        _keys(
            part,
            {
                "id",
                "name",
                "source_document_id",
                "source_digest",
                "output_feature_id",
                "mate_frames",
            },
        )
        _identifier(part["id"])
        _text(part["name"])
        _identifier(part["output_feature_id"])
        _require(
            expected_sources.get(part["source_document_id"]) == part["source_digest"],
            "definition source binding differs",
        )
        frames = _records(part["mate_frames"], MAX_FRAMES)
        frame_count += len(frames)
        for frame in frames.values():
            _keys(frame, {"id", "name", "placement"})
            _identifier(frame["id"])
            _text(frame["name"])
            _frame(frame["placement"])
    _require(frame_count <= MAX_FRAMES, "total frame count exceeds limit")
    for instance in instances.values():
        _keys(instance, {"id", "name", "part_id"})
        _identifier(instance["id"])
        _text(instance["name"])
        _require(instance["part_id"] in parts, "unknown definition instance")
    root = canonical["grounded_instance"]
    _require(root in instances, "missing ground instance")
    incoming = set()
    for joint in joints.values():
        base = {"id", "name", "kind", "parent", "child", "parent_frame", "child_frame"}
        _require(joint["kind"] in {"fixed", "slider", "revolute"}, "unsupported joint")
        _keys(joint, base if joint["kind"] == "fixed" else base | {"coordinate", "limits"})
        _identifier(joint["id"])
        _text(joint["name"])
        _require(
            joint["parent"] in instances and joint["child"] in instances, "unknown joint instance"
        )
        _require(
            joint["child"] != root
            and joint["child"] not in incoming
            and joint["child"] != joint["parent"],
            "invalid joint tree",
        )
        incoming.add(joint["child"])
        for end in ("parent", "child"):
            definition = parts[instances[joint[end]]["part_id"]]
            _require(
                joint[end + "_frame"] in {f["id"] for f in definition["mate_frames"]},
                "unknown joint frame",
            )
        bound = 1e4 if joint["kind"] == "revolute" else 1e6
        if joint["kind"] != "fixed":
            q = _number(joint["coordinate"], bound=bound)
            if joint["limits"] is not None:
                _vector(joint["limits"], 2, bound)
                lo, hi = joint["limits"]
                _require(lo < hi and lo <= q <= hi, "invalid authored limits")
    _require(incoming == set(instances) - {root}, "disconnected assembly")
    reached = {root}
    for _ in joints:
        reached.update(j["child"] for j in joints.values() if j["parent"] in reached)
    _require(reached == set(instances), "cyclic assembly")
    return canonical, parts, instances, joints


def validate_mesh(mesh):
    _keys(mesh, {"vertices", "triangles", "triangle_face_ids"})
    vertices, triangles = mesh["vertices"], mesh["triangles"]
    _require(
        type(vertices) is list and 0 < len(vertices) <= MAX_VERTICES, "invalid mesh vertex count"
    )
    _require(
        type(triangles) is list and 0 < len(triangles) <= MAX_TRIANGLES,
        "invalid mesh triangle count",
    )
    for point in vertices:
        _vector(point, 3, 1e8)
    for triangle in triangles:
        _require(
            type(triangle) is list
            and len(triangle) == 3
            and all(type(i) is int and 0 <= i < len(vertices) for i in triangle)
            and len(set(triangle)) == 3,
            "invalid triangle indices",
        )
    face_ids = mesh["triangle_face_ids"]
    _require(
        type(face_ids) is list
        and len(face_ids) == len(triangles)
        and all(i is None or type(i) is str for i in face_ids),
        "invalid mesh face provenance",
    )


def _parts(result, canonical, definitions, complete, *, strict=False, strict_v3=False):
    rows = _records(result["parts"], MAX_PARTS)
    _require(
        set(rows) <= set(definitions) and (not complete or set(rows) == set(definitions)),
        "missing or unexpected part mesh",
    )
    for identifier, row in rows.items():
        _keys(
            row,
            set(definitions[identifier]) | {"geometry_check", "mesh", "topology", "datum_policy"},
        )
        _require(
            {k: row[k] for k in definitions[identifier]} == definitions[identifier],
            "part definition identity or literal frame changed",
        )
        _require(
            row["datum_policy"] == "literal_part_local_coordinates", "unsupported datum policy"
        )
        validate_mesh(row["mesh"])
        checks = row["geometry_check"]
        _keys(checks, {"brep", "mesh", "linear_deflection_mm"})
        _number(checks["linear_deflection_mm"], minimum=0.001, bound=10)
        brep, mesh = checks["brep"], checks["mesh"]
        _require(
            type(brep) is dict
            and brep.get("valid") is True
            and type(brep.get("solids")) is int
            and brep["solids"] == 1,
            "unverified part B-rep",
        )
        _number(brep.get("volume"), minimum=1e-300)
        _require(
            type(mesh) is dict
            and all(
                mesh.get(k) is True
                for k in ("watertight", "consistently_oriented", "vertex_manifold")
            ),
            "unverified part tessellation",
        )
        _require(
            type(row["topology"]) is list and len(row["topology"]) <= MAX_TRIANGLES,
            "invalid topology metadata",
        )
    sources = {s["source_document_id"]: s for s in canonical["part_sources"]}
    replays = _records(result["source_replays"], MAX_PARTS, "source_document_id")
    _require(
        set(replays) <= set(sources) and (not complete or set(replays) == set(sources)),
        "source replay set mismatch",
    )
    for identifier, replay in replays.items():
        _keys(
            replay,
            {"source_document_id", "source_digest", "status", "features"}
            | ({"replay"} if strict_v3 else set()),
        )
        _require(
            replay["source_digest"] == sources[identifier]["source_digest"],
            "source replay hash mismatch",
        )
        _require(
            replay["status"] in {"ok", "failed"} and (not complete or replay["status"] == "ok"),
            "invalid source replay status",
        )
        features = _records(replay["features"], 256)
        expected = {f["id"] for f in sources[identifier]["document"]["features"]}
        _require(set(features) == expected, "source replay features differ")
        for feature in features.values():
            _keys(
                feature,
                {"id", "status", "error", "stats"} | ({"output"} if strict or strict_v3 else set()),
            )
            _require(
                feature["status"] in {"ok", "failed", "blocked"}
                and (not complete or feature["status"] == "ok"),
                "invalid replay feature status",
            )

    if strict_v3:
        _parts_v3(canonical, rows, replays)
    elif strict:
        _parts_v2(result, canonical, rows, replays)


def _source_output(feature, source):
    """Validate a summary's typed port without inventing unavailable solve evidence."""
    from .geometry_evidence import validate_stats

    output, status, kind = feature["output"], feature["status"], source["kind"]
    if status != "ok":
        _require(
            output is None and feature["stats"] is None, "failed source publishes usable output"
        )
        _keys(feature["error"], {"code", "message"})
        _text(feature["error"]["code"])
        _text(feature["error"]["message"], 100_000)
        _require(
            feature["error"]["code"].strip() and feature["error"]["message"].strip(),
            "failed source requires a readable error",
        )
        return None
    _require(feature["error"] is None, "successful source feature also contains an error")
    solid = kind in {"extrude", "cut"}
    if solid:
        validate_stats(feature["stats"])
    else:
        _require(feature["stats"] is None, "profile/sketch source cannot report solid statistics")
    if kind != "sketch_constrained":
        _keys(output, {"kind", "display"})
        _require(
            kind in {"sketch_rectangle", "sketch_circle", "extrude", "cut"}
            and output == {"kind": "solid" if solid else "profile", "display": "mesh"},
            "source output discriminant contradicts authored feature kind",
        )
        return output
    _keys(output, {"kind", "display", "profile"})
    _require(
        output["kind"] == "sketch" and output["display"] == "solved_sketch",
        "invalid source sketch discriminant",
    )
    sketch, profile = source["sketch"], output["profile"]
    _require(type(profile) is dict, "missing source profile availability")
    if profile.get("state") == "unavailable":
        _keys(profile, {"state", "reason"})
        _keys(profile["reason"], {"code", "message"})
        _require(
            sketch["schema_version"] == 2
            and not sketch.get("circles")
            and bool(sketch["lines"])
            and profile["reason"]["code"] == "open_profile",
            "unsupported unavailable source profile",
        )
        _text(profile["reason"]["message"], 100_000)
        _require(
            profile["reason"]["message"].strip(), "unavailable profile needs a readable reason"
        )
    else:
        _keys(profile, {"state", "region_kind"})
        _require(profile["state"] == "available", "unknown source profile state")
        _require(
            (
                profile["region_kind"] == "circle"
                and len(sketch.get("circles", [])) == 1
                and not sketch["lines"]
            )
            or (
                profile["region_kind"] == "line_loop"
                and not sketch.get("circles")
                and len(sketch["lines"]) >= 3
            ),
            "source profile region contradicts authored curve kinds",
        )
    return output


def _parts_v2(result, canonical, rows, replays):
    """Strict v2 evidence algebra; legacy v1 acceptance remains frozen above."""
    from .geometry_evidence import validate_geometry_check
    from .topology_evidence import validate_topology

    sources = canonical["part_sources"]
    _require(
        list(replays) == [source["source_document_id"] for source in sources][: len(replays)],
        "source replay order differs from canonical source order",
    )
    source_features, summaries = {}, {}
    for source in sources:
        identifier = source["source_document_id"]
        source_features[identifier] = source["document"]["features"]
        if identifier not in replays:
            continue
        replay = replays[identifier]
        authored = source_features[identifier]
        _require(
            [feature["id"] for feature in replay["features"]]
            == [feature["id"] for feature in authored],
            "source feature order differs from canonical history",
        )
        features = {feature["id"]: feature for feature in replay["features"]}
        summaries[identifier] = features
        outputs = {
            feature["id"]: _source_output(feature, source_feature)
            for feature, source_feature in zip(replay["features"], authored, strict=True)
        }
        for source_feature in authored:
            feature = features[source_feature["id"]]
            dependencies = source_feature["inputs"]
            unavailable = any(outputs[target] is None for target in dependencies.values())
            profile = outputs.get(dependencies.get("profile"))
            open_profile = (
                profile is not None
                and profile["kind"] == "sketch"
                and profile["profile"]["state"] == "unavailable"
            )
            if unavailable:
                _require(
                    feature["status"] == "blocked"
                    and feature["error"]["code"] == "upstream_failed",
                    "source feature uses a failed or blocked dependency",
                )
            elif feature["status"] == "blocked":
                _require(
                    open_profile and feature["error"]["code"] == "profile_unavailable",
                    "blocked source feature has no unavailable input port",
                )
            if feature["status"] == "ok":
                for port, target in dependencies.items():
                    value = outputs[target]
                    _require(
                        value is not None
                        and (
                            (
                                port == "profile"
                                and (
                                    value["kind"] == "profile"
                                    or value["kind"] == "sketch"
                                    and value["profile"]["state"] == "available"
                                )
                            )
                            or (port in {"base", "tool"} and value["kind"] == "solid")
                        ),
                        "successful source feature consumes an unavailable or wrong input port",
                    )
        expected_status = (
            "ok" if all(feature["status"] == "ok" for feature in features.values()) else "failed"
        )
        _require(
            replay["status"] == expected_status, "source replay status contradicts feature evidence"
        )
    failed = [identifier for identifier, replay in replays.items() if replay["status"] != "ok"]
    _require(
        not failed or failed == list(replays)[-1:] and not rows,
        "assembly continued or published parts after failed source replay",
    )
    if rows:
        _require(
            list(rows) == [part["id"] for part in canonical["parts"]]
            and len(replays) == len(sources),
            "part publication requires all canonical definitions and source replays",
        )
    for row in rows.values():
        identifier, output_id = row["source_document_id"], row["output_feature_id"]
        feature = summaries[identifier][output_id]
        _require(
            feature["status"] == "ok" and feature["output"] == {"kind": "solid", "display": "mesh"},
            "selected assembly output is not an evaluated solid",
        )
        checks = row["geometry_check"]
        validate_geometry_check(
            checks,
            linear_deflection=checks["linear_deflection_mm"],
            stats=feature["stats"],
            mesh=row["mesh"],
        )
        authored = {feature["id"]: feature for feature in source_features[identifier]}
        topology = validate_topology(
            row["topology"],
            feature_id=output_id,
            kind=authored[output_id]["kind"],
            mesh=row["mesh"],
            source_features=source_features[identifier],
        )
        _require(
            feature["stats"]["faces"] == len(topology), "solid face count differs from topology"
        )


def _parts_v3(canonical, rows, replays):
    """Bind integrated Assembly display to complete source-bound replay-3 evidence."""
    from . import part_snapshot_bridge, result_v3
    from .geometry_evidence import validate_geometry_check

    sources = canonical["part_sources"]
    _require(
        list(replays) == [source["source_document_id"] for source in sources][: len(replays)],
        "source replay order differs from canonical source order",
    )
    outputs = {}
    for source in sources:
        # Preflight every source, even an unused one or one after a failed replay.
        document = part_snapshot_bridge._expected_document(source["document"])
        _require(
            fingerprint(document) == fingerprint(source["document"]),
            "source replay requires canonical Part source",
        )
        result_v3._graph(document, replay=True)
        identifier = source["source_document_id"]
        if identifier not in replays:
            continue
        replay = replays[identifier]
        body = replay["replay"]
        result_v3._validate_replay_body(document, body)
        projection = [
            {key: feature[key] for key in ("id", "status", "error", "stats", "output")}
            for feature in body["features"]
        ]
        _require(
            replay["status"] == body["status"]
            and fingerprint(replay["features"]) == fingerprint(projection),
            "source replay summary differs from complete replay evidence",
        )
        outputs[identifier] = {feature["id"]: feature for feature in body["features"]}
    failed = [identifier for identifier, replay in replays.items() if replay["status"] != "ok"]
    _require(
        not failed or failed == list(replays)[-1:] and not rows,
        "assembly continued or published parts after failed source replay",
    )
    if rows:
        _require(
            list(rows) == [part["id"] for part in canonical["parts"]]
            and len(replays) == len(sources),
            "part publication requires all canonical definitions and source replays",
        )
    for row in rows.values():
        source = outputs[row["source_document_id"]]
        output_id = row["output_feature_id"]
        _require(output_id in source, "selected assembly output is missing from source replay")
        feature = source[output_id]
        _require(
            feature["status"] == "ok" and feature["output"] == {"kind": "solid", "display": "mesh"},
            "selected assembly output is not an evaluated solid",
        )
        _require(
            fingerprint(row["mesh"]) == fingerprint(feature["mesh"])
            and fingerprint(row["topology"]) == fingerprint(feature["topology"]),
            "part display differs from selected source replay geometry",
        )
        checks = row["geometry_check"]
        validate_geometry_check(
            checks,
            linear_deflection=checks["linear_deflection_mm"],
            stats=feature["stats"],
            mesh=row["mesh"],
        )
